newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGIP, De Benedetti seek to buy Cerus - paper.
newsitem.headline: CGIP, De Benedetti seek to buy Cerus - paper.

text.p: Compagnie Generale d'Industrie et de Participations (CGIP) and Italian industrialist Carlo De Benedetti are negotiating a buyout of Cerus, which owns 28 percent of Valeo, the newspaper Les Echos said.
It did not disclose the amount of the buyout proposed for Cerus but said CGIP estimated the value of Cerus's stake in car parts manufacturer Valeo at 330-350 francs per share.

"The acquisition of Valeo by CGIP would satisfy the peripheral parties concerned -- the French carmakers and the public authorities," the newspaper said. It cited unnamed sources and said CGIP and De Benedetti had no comment.
A spokesman for Cerus said the company had no comment on the report.
